outcome: Composite neonatal outcome (stillbirth, 5 min APGAR < 7, Special Care Nursery admission)
cohort: 1165 women ≥ 28 weeks' gestation with a singleton pregnancy who presented with concerns regarding DFM, compared to 4706 controls
finding: Women presenting with DFM were younger, had higher BMI, and more mental health conditions, and while there was no difference in neonatal outcomes between groups, women with DFM had higher induction rates, and increasing presentations for DFM correlated with increased inductions.
mod_finding: Women presenting with decreased fetal movements were more likely to have an induction of labor.
